description: Reviewed D-188 exemptions. Each row moves intermediate (I) leaves to audit (action 'audit') or marks an intermediate list as unordered (action 'unordered'), and must give a reason. The comparator refuses any row that touches an input-precondition (P), decision (D) or registered-number (R) leaf, statically by rule overlap and dynamically per leaf. Rows: {role, path, action, reason}.
